_notes: Bela Trill Bar - 1D capacitive touch, 26 channels, up to 5 simultaneous touches. CENTROID mode. Identify cmd returns device_type=1 in byte 1 of 3-byte response. Address jumper-configurable 0x20-0x27. Init, as Bela's Trill library (Trill-Linux) for the Bar: CENTROID mode; prescaler 2; scan settings speed 0, 12 bits; a baseline update; noise threshold 40 (0x28 at 12 bits). Poll: up to 5 touches, positions (loc, 0 to 3200 = 25 x 128 over 26 channels; 65535 for no touch) then sizes (size, 0 for no touch) as 5-element arrays; the dashboard shows them with its touch strip visualizer (vt touchstrip). Not bench tested since the init change (the Flex was: without the prescaler set, every channel read 4095 and no touch was seen). Source: the default mode, prescaler and noise threshold are from the defaults table of Bela's Trill library (https://github.com/BelaPlatform/Bela libraries/Trill, LGPL-3.0; also Trill-Linux); only those values and the sensor's documented commands are used, not the library's code (see RaftCore's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

rsao.note: Trill firmware v2: the first byte is a buffer offset and 0x99 is beyond the 64-byte buffer, so it is NACKed and ignored; reads have no side effects (BelaPlatform/Trill 537ebd6). Firmware v3 isn't public

actions.desc: Noise threshold (counts at 12 bits; 40 is the Trill library's default)
Prescaler (higher reads lower; raise it if channels saturate at 4095)
